exposure: placental abnormalities (previa, abruption, adhesion, retained placenta)
cohort: 336 pregnant women who delivered at a single hospital between January 2022 and January 2024 were included.
finding: An internally validated nomogram demonstrated strong predictive performance for postpartum hemorrhage using routinely collected clinical and psychosocial data.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery and instrumental delivery were identified as independent predictors of postpartum hemorrhage.
